member.name: T:Padlocks.Padlock`1
member.summary: Padlock is a lightweight, high-performance library that provides key-based locking for multithreaded applications. It enables granular locking on specific resources identified by keys of any type, allowing for efficient concurrency control without unnecessary blocking.
member.remarks: Every instance emits metrics and spans through the meter and the activity source, labeled with . Emission is best-effort and costs a few flag checks when nothing subscribes. See TELEMETRY.md for the full catalog.

member.name: P:Padlocks.Padlock`1.Name
member.summary: Gets or sets the name used as the padlock.name label on this instance's metrics and spans. Default is "default". Use a small, fixed set of names (for example one per subsystem); never derive the name from a key, an id, or user input, because every distinct name creates new metric series. Instances that share a name are aggregated together. The name may be changed at any time and applies to subsequent operations.
member.exception: Thrown when the value is null.
Thrown when the value is empty or whitespace.

member.name: M:Padlocks.Padlock`1.SetMaxCount(System.Int32)
member.summary: Updates the maximum number of concurrent holders for this instance.
member.remarks: The new limit is applied lazily. It takes effect for any key acquired after this call, and for any currently-idle key the next time it is acquired (including lock entries recycled from the pool). A key that is active at the moment of the call keeps its existing limit until every holder and waiter releases and its entry becomes idle; the next acquisition then adopts the new limit. As a result, increases become visible as keys are acquired or recycled, while a decrease only takes effect for a given key once that key drains to zero holders at least once. Existing holders are never evicted.
member.param: New maximum number of concurrent holders. Must be at least 1.

member.name: T:Padlocks.PadlockInstrumentation
member.summary: Process-wide Padlock meter, activity source, and instruments. Every method is best-effort: a failure inside instrumentation (including an exception thrown by a subscribed listener) is swallowed and never affects locking.

member.name: T:Padlocks.PadlockTelemetry
member.summary: Stable public names for the telemetry Padlock emits through and . These names are a public contract consumed by collectors and dashboards and do not change between minor versions.
member.remarks: Padlock takes no dependency on any telemetry SDK or exporter. A host subscribes by name, for example with Radiant (settings.Sources.AddMeter(PadlockTelemetry.MeterName) and settings.Sources.AddActivitySource(PadlockTelemetry.ActivitySourceName)) or with the OpenTelemetry SDK (AddMeter / AddSource). When nothing subscribes, emission costs a few flag checks and allocates nothing. This class is thread safe; it contains only constants.
